description_short: Housing placement overhaul. Housing & Town Services share one economy and can be built anywheres. No cheaty number changes.
description_long: All player Housing shares one global vanilla Settlement economy, allowing physically separate cities to function together anywhere on the island. Population, housing capacity, food, water, wastewater, electricity, household goods, appliances, electronics, luxury goods, computing, healthcare, waste, recyclables, biowaste, health, and Unity are evaluated across the combined Settlement. Town Services and Settlement Decorations can be placed away from Housing while retaining their normal requirements and effects. Grid snapping can be enabled or disabled while placing Housing, Town Services, or Settlement Decorations. Building buffers, pipes, trucks, and logistics remain physical, local, and vanilla.
